dialogues.speaker: Beaumont Workshop
dialogues.text: Beaumont Workshop: A better workshop than the Fontaine Research Institute! Our automated forging machine, unique in all Teyvat, creates unique beauty, customized for you.

dialogues.speaker: Beaumont Workshop
dialogues.text: Feel free to visit! We offer customization based on pictures.

dialogues.speaker: Maison Gardiennage
dialogues.text: "Fontaine Research Institute," "all of Teyvat," and "unique" are all in violation of the advertisement regulations of Fontaine. The offending merchant is to change their advertising to comply with relevant regulations immediately.

dialogues.speaker: Beaumont Workshop
dialogues.text: Beaumont Workshop: A better workshop than "some research institute"! Our automated forging machine, relatively special in half of Teyvat, creates relatively special beauty, customized for you.
